questions.question: What is the main warning of Proverbs 5?
options: Against the sin of a proud heart
Against the snare of strong drink
Against the deep love of money and gain

questions.question: What positive instruction does Proverbs 5 give about marriage?
options: Choose yourself a wife only for her wealth and the great honor of her house
Guard your own freedom carefully and do not bind yourself to any one woman
Take to yourself many wives so that your household may grow great and large
Rejoice in the wife of your youth and drink water from your own cistern
questions.answer: Rejoice in the wife of your youth and drink water from your own cistern

questions.question: Proverbs 5 says the lips of a forbidden woman drip honey, but in the end she is bitter as wormwood.
Drink water from your own _____, flowing water from your own well.
Rejoice in the wife of your _____.
